contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IVLIA MAESA AVG ; R/ PVDICITIA

Silver coin. Denarius of Julia Maesa (218-222), mint of Rome issue of 218-220, Sear vol. 2 no. 7765 citing RIC volume 4 part 2 no. 268. Obverse description: Bust draped and coiffed right. Obverse inscription: IVLIA MAESA AVG. Reverse description: Pudicitia seated left holding sceptre and drawing veil. Reverse inscription: PVDICITIA. Diameter: 17.9mm, Weight: 2.21gms, die axis: 12
